content.short: SonarX delivers institutional blockchain datasets via cloud data shares, streaming and file delivery.
content.description: SonarX delivers indexed blockchain data across more than 130 chains, with smart contracts decoded and a documented data quality framework behind it. Teams take it as real-time streaming or scheduled loads into the warehouse they already query. The company holds SOC 2 compliance and prices to scale with volume rather than per seat. Its leadership includes former ConsenSys managing partner Vanessa Grellet.
content.meta: Chain data delivered into Snowflake, BigQuery and Databricks rather than behind another API.
